title: Existence of Gibbs measures for sequences of continuous functions
summary: We give a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of invariant Gibbs measures for sequences of continuous functions on one-sided subshifts and, more generally, for the existence of Gibbs measures. These extend the results of Kim [7] and Baker and Ghenciu [2], respectively, to sequences of continuous functions on one-sided subshifts. In particular, we characterize the existence of invariant Gibbs measures for subadditive sequences.
